text:
Maya (People Ops): FYI we're finalizing midcycle promo ops this week. dropping quick Q&A here so managers have one place to reference.
Jordan (Eng Manager): first question 1: if an IC is promoted effective 6/1 but payroll cutoffs miss it, can we backdate pay?
Luis (Payroll): short version: yes in most cases but we need the signed comp-change + approval by payroll cutoff. otherwise we do a retro pay in the next cycle. allow 2 pay periods for processing.
Jordan (Eng Manager): what's the payroll cutoff date exactly?
Maya (People Ops): payroll needs final approvals in the system by 2025-05-22 17:00 PT to hit the June 1 pay. approvals after that will be retro.
Priya (People Ops Partner): note: managers should submit comp-change forms *and* attach the approval thread link. that speeds audits.
Tess (Hiring Ops): related: if we're opening a backfill before the promo is finalized, tag the req `promo-backfill-temp` so hiring ops can prioritize shortlisting. no headcount approvals changed by that tag alone.
Jordan (Eng Manager): international edge cases: UK/EMEA hires have different payroll calendars. how do we coordinate?
Luis (Payroll): EMEA payroll runs earlier. for UK/EMEA effective dates, confirm with payroll at least 10 business days prior. we have a small checklist for EMEA in the payroll handbook.
Priya (People Ops Partner): also remember taxes and local labor rules may prevent retroactive effective dates beyond 30 days in some countries. loop in Legal for anything unusual.
Jordan (Eng Manager): evidence transfer: someone moved teams post-submission. do i need to re-submit evidence or is a manager transfer enough?
Maya (People Ops): if the "manager of record" changed in Workday before cutoff, we include the new manager's evidence set. otherwise re-submit or use the evidence-transfer form. link: https://intranet.redwood.com/tools/evidence-transfer
Jordan (Eng Manager): and if the evidence files are large (recordings, decks), any size limits or preferred hosts?
Tess (Hiring Ops): prefer shared drive with permission set to the new manager + `people-ops@redwood.com`. avoid personal drives. we hit sync issues less often that way. max recommended upload size per file is 500MB.
Priya (People Ops Partner): escalation path: if something got missed in the packet (e.g., missing evidence at calibration), managers have 48 hours after calibration notices to submit a correction request. we run a small verification sweep after that.
Jordan (Eng Manager): what about leveling appeals post-calibration?
Maya (People Ops): appeal window is 14 calendar days after the official manager notification. appeals go to a panel (manager, 2 peers, people ops partner). panel decisions are final for the cycle.
Luis (Payroll): admin note: if appeals change comp after payroll cutoff, expect retroactive adjustments. flag payroll ASAP if a pending appeal might affect comp.
Jordan (Eng Manager): any guidance on communicating promos to ICs vs managers?
Priya (People Ops Partner): best practice: manager informs the IC first, then update system records, then notify the wider org if applicable. for sensitive roles we coordinate comms with Comms.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Midcycle promo packet cutoff" on 2025-05-22 09:00 PT.
Maya (People Ops): i'll post the manager checklist and the evidence-transfer template to #people-ops-resources and the playbook repo. ping @Priya for exceptions.
Jordan (Eng Manager): great 44d  thanks everyone, will cascade to my managers now.
